explication: Bun is a single-executable JavaScript/TypeScript toolkit: its principal user workflow is invoking `bun` to run an app or script, with built-in package management, bundling, and testing as major companion capabilities. The graph combines README-documented product flows with source-indexed implementation areas. Several capabilities are documented but their runtime wiring was not sampled, so those links are cited to the README rather than presented as source-verified calls.
